title: Chlorination System
model_title: Gas Chlorination System (Vacuum-Operated Chlorinator, Ejector, Diffuser)

introduction.definition: A gas chlorination system disinfects water with chlorine drawn from ton containers. The whole system works under vacuum: the ejector creates suction, the vacuum regulator on the container valve lets gas flow only while vacuum exists, the chlorinator meters the dose, and the ejector dissolves the gas into a water stream that is injected into a baffled contact tank.
applications: Drinking-water disinfection and residual in distribution
Cooling-water biocide and wastewater effluent disinfection
key_points: Vacuum operation: a broken line draws in air, it does not leak gas
Leak detection and scrubbers in the chlorine room
introduction.summary: A gas chlorination system draws chlorine from ton containers under vacuum. The chlorinator meters the gas, an ejector dissolves it into a water stream, and the solution is injected into the contact tank to disinfect the water.

pressure.title: Vacuum operation is a safety feature
pressure.description: Gas is drawn from the container by vacuum created at the ejector. If the vacuum is lost (line break, ejector failure) the vacuum regulator at the container valve closes automatically, so chlorine gas under pressure never travels through the building. Dose is set on the rotameter (e.g. kg/day); disinfection depends on C·t (residual × contact time).

script.narration: This module introduces the Chlorination System.
A gas chlorination system disinfects water with chlorine drawn from ton containers.

The whole system works under vacuum: the ejector creates suction, the vacuum regulator on the container valve lets gas flow only while vacuum exists, the chlorinator meters the dose, and the ejector dissolves the gas into a water stream that is injected into a baffled contact tank.
Typical applications include drinking-water disinfection and residual in distribution; cooling-water biocide and wastewater effluent disinfection.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.

video_tutorials.title: Chlorination System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Chlorination System.
Check residual, gas usage and vacuum.
Test leak detector and alarms.
Overhaul regulators and ejector check valves.
Watch for loss of vacuum: no feed, alarm. Common cause: ejector blocked, low motive water pressure.
Watch for chlorine leak: detector alarm, odour. Common cause: damaged gasket at container valve.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
